info.title: FishGate Public API
info.description: Company-scoped Property Management, Marketplace, and CRM API. API keys are disclosed once; breaking deprecations receive at least 90 days notice.

tags.name: CRM
tags.description: Leads, deals, activity, documents, automation, and trust.

get.description: Requires Limited tier and `pm:read` scope. Rate limits are enforced per API key per minute.

x-codeSamples.source: curl -X GET "$BASE_URL/v1/properties" -H "Authorization: Bearer $FISHGATE_API_KEY"

const response = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/v1/properties`, { method: 'GET', headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${apiKey}` } });
const result = await response.json();

post.description: Requires Full tier and `pm:write` scope. Rate limits are enforced per API key per minute.

const response = await fetch(`${baseUrl}/v1/properties`, { method: 'POST', headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${apiKey}`, 'Idempotency-Key': crypto.randomUUID(), 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ name: 'Example' }) });
const result = await response.json();
